mapper.sql: SELECT br.serNum AS fineId, br.serNum AS recNo, br.barCode, b.bname AS bookName, b.author, br.fineMoney AS amount, CASE WHEN br.fineStatus = '未缴' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS payStatus, br.retDate, br.realRetDate, br.realRetDate AS createTime, br.ovdDays AS overdueDays, br.sno, s.username AS studentName FROM borrowrec br JOIN bookcopy bc ON br.barCode = bc.barCode JOIN book b ON bc.ISBN = b.ISBN LEFT JOIN student s ON br.sno = s.sno WHERE br.fineMoney > 0
mapper.select: SELECT serNum, sno, barCode, borDate, retDate, realRetDate, retStatus, ovdDays, fineMoney, fineStatus, paySerNum FROM borrowrec WHERE serNum = #{serNum}
AND br.sno = #{sno} ORDER BY br.realRetDate DESC

AND CASE WHEN br.fineStatus = '未缴' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = #{payStatus}
ORDER BY br.realRetDate DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fineMoney), 0) FROM borrowrec WHERE sno = #{sno} AND fineStatus = '未缴' AND fineMoney > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrowrec WHERE sno = #{sno} AND fineStatus = '未缴' AND fineMoney > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrowrec WHERE fineStatus = '未缴' AND fineMoney > 0
